caption: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
positive_analysis:
Two men holding the ends of a thin wooden strip and pushing down bends it into a curve.
The wood's flexibility allows the continuous material to deform smoothly into a bow shape without breaking.
Maintaining downward pressure at the center keeps the wood bent while the ends remain held.

negative_analysis:
The men hold the vertical ends of a wooden frame bent downward at the center.
A thin string connects the upper tips of the frame.
If the men pull apart, the string may tighten or the wood may straighten.
